entries.name: encode_nbits_global_control-accept#0
entries.script: `Global.encodeNbits(BigInt 1)` with the receiver `Global` — the CONTROL. Evaluates to `16842752L` at cost 39.  // row 1 of the probe

entries.name: encode_nbits_int_receiver-errored#1
entries.script: `encodeNbits` with the receiver an `Int` CONSTANT. Parses — the serializer checks no receiver — and the reflective invoke then refuses it. **SEPARATING:** an implementation whose evaluator never reads its receiver returns the control's value instead.  // row 2 of the probe

entries.name: encode_nbits_context_receiver-errored#2
entries.script: `encodeNbits` with the receiver `CONTEXT` — a wrong receiver that is nonetheless a first-class one, not a constant. Same refusal, which is what shows the check is about the KIND and not about constant-versus-node. **SEPARATING.**  // row 3 of the probe
